revisions.purpose: Add fixed, non-sensitive sign-in callback diagnostics for the reviewed service error codes and browser proof failures, reject ambiguous ticket/error callbacks, and refresh the offline app shell. No shared news/candidate functions, initialization, predictions, private-note access policy or public endpoint configuration change.
revisions.configuration_policy: team-auth-config.js is a public endpoint configuration, parsed and loaded in exact order but not source-hash pinned. The API origin can be configured independently; authentication and allowed-origin behavior have dedicated tests.

all prior reviewed revision records with ordered counts and complete content hashes
candidate predictions and five-fold probability ranges
fixed callback error messages without reflecting provider text or secrets
